content_policy: No mathematical source corrections silently applied. Full source text translated; source defects and reconstruction caveats remain in per-fragment statuses.

changes.details: base change→基变换, excellent→优, derived category→导出范畴, resolution→消解, acyclic→无上同调; names and book titles kept in original script.
Separate ASCII control words from following CJK; remove blank paragraphs inside math displays. Mathematical tokens unchanged.
Chinese chapter/contents/bibliography/editor-note labels and text macros; inherited AMS/SMF geometry/headings/fonts retained, with Noto CJK support.
Frozen-source labels outside X–XIX are rendered as original explicit citations/source-backed numbers without dead internal links; no synthetic pages or missing content.

XII long pair of limit isomorphisms reflowed into gathered; two inline prose line breaks added. XVII §1 diagram column gap1em→0.5em; §2 diagram2em→1.8em; §4 prism -.27cm→-.34cm. XVIII1.3.18 eqnarray last equality reflowed; XVIII3.1.5 Hom chain reflowed into gathered. No symbol/index/arrow changes.
XVIII Lemma2.3 missing closing parenthesis restored, logged by translator. English ordinal/citation-label prose localized; mathematical ordinals/numbers retained.

Chinese captions set immediately after begin{document} to take precedence over polyglossia hooks. Remaining structural/adj/adjunction/where diagram and formula prose labels translated, with no mathematical symbol changes.
